basic_info.description: 21st century retrofit behind the walls if this classic make this 3 bed/2 bath penthouse flat the perfect place to call home in one of the most iconic neighborhoods in the city, in the country, in the world. Perched just steps from Golden Gate Park, this home enjoys southern outlooks towards Clarendon Heights and even more expansive 360 outlook on the exclusive roof deck. An expansive open living and dining area adjoin the well-appointed chef's kitchen that offers all the style and convenience every modern city dweller could ask for. Well-proportioned bedrooms and bathrooms allow for freedom of movement around the home. There is a large, dedicated office bathed in natural light. New dual pane windows wash the home in natural light while preserving the quiet and calm. With all new systems and structural reinforcement throughout, sleep tight knowing your home has been fortified for the next generations to come. With over 1600sq' of landscaped terrain, the shared backyard offers plenty of space for all to enjoy BBQ and weekend socials. 1 car garage parking. In-unit laundry, AIR CONDITIONING, and a separate office space round out this complete luxury residence. Walkscore 98, Bike Score 94. 1 block to Whole Foods and Haight corridor, 4 blocks to Cole Valley
